findings.description: Fixture A specifies body=55 chars, but the gate is summary>200 AND body<50. 55 does not satisfy body<50 — the fixture would NOT block under the stated threshold.
findings.resolution: Fixture A body changed to 45 (unambiguously < 50). Added Fixture A2 boundary case testing 200/49 (block), 200/49 with summary=200 (allows — strict >), and 201/50 (allows — strict <).

findings.section: Approach > Implementation Strategy + Acceptance Criteria > Item 4
findings.description: Plan referenced logging to `audit-log.jsonl`, but the codebase logs via `appendLog()` to `.crews/logs/crews.log`. No `audit-log.jsonl` sink exists.
findings.resolution: Replaced all audit-log.jsonl references with appendLog to crews.log. Specified literal markers `body-canonical: block` and `body-canonical: bypassed-on-retry` for grep-based assertions.

findings.description: Multi-remote push acceptance criterion was unsafe: 'push to all configured remotes' without naming them or requiring approval.
findings.resolution: AC#10 now names exact remotes (`origin`, `work`). Mandates kind=question to operator before pushing main if uncertainty exists. Hard prohibition on git push --force or pushing to unnamed remotes without approval. Referenced auto-memory feedback_fix_architecture_not_workarounds.

findings.description: Line citations were stale by ~8 lines (parseTurnTags actually at 641, not 633; listener-arm gate at 684-690, not 675-681; appendOutbox at 797, not 782-789).
findings.resolution: Updated line citations to nominal v1.7.3 values with explicit note that implementer re-verifies at implementation time as the file is edited frequently.

findings.description: New hard-block path missed `bumpBlockCount()` call (existing Stop hard-blocks all call it; without it, v1.4.x circuit-breaker protection is bypassed).
findings.resolution: US-002 now explicitly calls `bumpBlockCount(state.name, crew, cwd, state.role, 'body not canonical')` before the block-decision write. Added as AC#2 bullet.

findings.description: `isRetry` derives from `stop_hook_active`, but runStop test harness can't set the field. Tests as written cannot exercise the retry path.
findings.resolution: Added new story US-002b: extend runStop to accept optional stopHookActive param. Renamed AC#4 from 'isRetry' to actual input field 'stop_hook_active === true'. Fixture E updated.

findings.description: setupForceResponse default fixtures seed a consumed mailbox message that would block on strict-ack gate BEFORE the body-canonical gate, masking the intended test reasons.
findings.resolution: AC#7 now explicitly requires `setupForceResponse({ messages: [], ... })` in every fixture. Also called out in US-003 instructions.

findings.description: Import path for helper was ambiguous (direct vs via config.js re-export). BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS overlap with tagKindEnum.
findings.resolution: US-001 clarifies BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS is a strict-subset frozen array kept separate from tagKindEnum for intent clarity. US-002 specifies direct require from `./protocol/report-tags` (mirrors the parseTurnTags import pattern).

findings.description: Progress-exemption AC didn't explicitly state exemption is unconditional regardless of thresholds.
findings.resolution: AC#3 strengthened: progress NEVER triggers regardless of summary.length, body.length, or env-overridden thresholds. Added Fixture D2 with adversarial thresholds (cap=0, floor=100000) confirming exemption holds.

findings.description: Gate placement was ambiguously specified as 'before empty-body and listener-arm' though those are themselves sequential.
findings.resolution: US-002 now specifies exact position: AFTER missing-kind block AND consumed-inbox eval, BEFORE `decideStopBlock()` listener-arm gate. Rationale documented.

findings.description: 'no logging' on CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL=off was too broad; other Stop-hook gates may still log.
findings.resolution: AC#5 reworded: assert absence of literal substring `body-canonical` from crews.log for the fixture's run; other unrelated log lines may still appear.
